command: set -euo pipefail; adb shell input tap 503 159; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do sleep 1; if adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'ScannerService'; then break; fi; done; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'ScannerService'; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -E 'ScannerService|isForeground=true|startRequested=true'; sleep 4; adb shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/tracker-restarted.xml >/dev/null; echo '--- UI_SAMPLE ---'; adb shell cat /sdcard/tracker-restarted.xml | grep -oE 'text="[^"]*"' | grep -v 'text=""' | head -n 30; echo '--- ERRORS ---'; PID=$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); test -n "$PID"; adb logcat -d -v brief --pid="$PID" | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|AndroidRuntime|SecurityException|IllegalStateException|SQLiteException|OutOfMemoryError' && exit 33 || true; echo START_RUNNING_NO_ERRORS_PASS
